title: Gold, silver prices crash up to 53% from January peak. Time to buy before Dhanteras, festive season? - The Economic Times
text:
Gold and silver prices have corrected sharply from their January peaks, raising questions about whether the fall offers a buying opportunity ahead of Dhanteras and the wedding season. Experts recommend staggered purchases over lump-sum investments, while highlighting interest rates, the US dollar, inflation and industrial demand as key drivers of prices.
